title: run-meta
description: Stage run metadata. Link the authoritative brief and declare its signature actions; capabilities route implementation and checks.

control_scheme.description: Control hint from the brief; actual controls and camera belong in implementation.

player_modality.description: The brief's player_modality the run implements.

core_verb.description: The player action or connected action sequence implemented by this run.

gate.description: One line naming this stage's acceptance gate (shown on the card).

modules.description: Library modules the run imports, as /assets/... paths, for the card's provenance. Checkers do not treat this list as proof of import; catalog reuse is the runtime import graph or implementation.catalog_skips.

controls.description: Human-readable player controls. Checkers never infer input semantics by parsing these strings.

out_of_scope.description: Intentional scope exclusions and behavior deferred to a later build stage; do not silently drop requested defining actions.

scene_manifest.description: Path to the static scene manifest emitted by the scene stage, relative to this run.

capabilities.description: Composable capability IDs from grimoire/review/capability-matrix.md; use custom:<name> for an uncovered capability and document its checks. No genre implies an entire bundle. An empty list is valid when the stage only contains static scene work.

brief.description: Path to the authoritative brief, relative to this run directory or absolute. Supplies validation time budget. With explicit --project-root, the resolved path must stay inside that root, including symlink targets.

catalog_skips.description: When a catalog camera, combat or resource module was considered and not imported, record the path and why. Omit the array when a matching module is imported by the run page, or none apply. Listing a path in modules is provenance, not an import.

considered.description: Catalog path under assets/, for example assets/camera/PoseFollowCameraRig.js

input_checks.description: Real bound actions with assertions against window.__gameTest.read(). At least one check must change an asserted gameplay field. See grimoire/review/input-contract.md.

signature_actions.description: Brief-derived defining actions; scene drafts may be empty, behavior requires success/boundary input proof.

capability_checks.description: For behavior, map each declared capability to input check names covering its relevant success and boundary.
